name: Taewoo Lee
introduction: I am a Research Officer for National Defense at the Agency for Defense Development (ADD). My research focuses on perception for off-road autonomous navigation.
about: I research off-road traversability estimation and semantic segmentation, with interests in 3D scene understanding and multimodal LiDAR–vision–language perception.

My work includes LiDAR reflectivity image-based object detection and vision-language model-based traversability estimation. I also write about AI trends, AI transformation (AX), and my research and study notes.
interests: Semantic Segmentation and Foundation Model Supervision
